configurePresets.name: cpu-check
configurePresets.displayName: CPU check build (no GPU, no network)
configurePresets.description: The fast check: the CPU-only engine pieces and every test that needs no GPU and no model, the conversation cache and park pool tests included. STRATA_NATIVE_EXPERTS=OFF, so ggml is not needed. tools/check runs this preset.

configurePresets.name: cpu-check-native
configurePresets.displayName: CPU check build with the native expert tests
configurePresets.description: As cpu-check plus the native (IQ) expert kernels and their tests. ggml comes from the vendored third_party/strata-ggml (no download); -DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=<llama.cpp checkout> overrides it.

configurePresets.name: cuda-compile
configurePresets.displayName: CUDA compile-only (the release flags of packaging/build_cuda_linux.sh, no tests)
configurePresets.description: Builds the strata target for the given CUDA architectures. No GPU is needed to compile; nothing is run. ggml is the vendored third_party/strata-ggml; -DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=<llama.cpp checkout> overrides it.

configurePresets.name: hip-compile
configurePresets.displayName: HIP compile-only (the release flags of packaging/build_hip_linux.sh, no tests)
configurePresets.description: Builds the strata target for gfx1100 and gfx1201 with ROCm's hipcc. ggml is the vendored third_party/strata-ggml (-DSTRATA_GGML_DIR=<llama.cpp checkout> overrides it); if hipcc is not on PATH pass -DCMAKE_HIP_COMPILER=<rocm>/llvm/bin/clang++.

configurePresets.name: hip-gfx90a-m1
configurePresets.displayName: Experimental gfx90a M1 compile and link (no GPU required)
configurePresets.description: Linux gfx90a wave64 compat engine, with the independent split engine off. Use ROCm clang++ as CMAKE_HIP_COMPILER; this preset does not run GPU code.

configurePresets.name: hip-gfx90a-tests
configurePresets.displayName: Experimental gfx90a M1 with host and GPU test targets
configurePresets.description: Compile and link the gfx90a tests without a GPU. The matching test preset requires a real gfx90a GPU; CI runs only the host policy test.
